What of NetBox `4.6.8` this operator covers and what it does not, joined from the schema IR
and the Descriptor registry. Deliberate absences are declared in
[`hack/coverage-exclusions.yaml`](../hack/coverage-exclusions.yaml); everything else in a
`MISSING` or `blocked` row is a gap, and a gap is a ticket somebody still owes.

Regenerate with `make coverage` after every schema regeneration (`docs/regenerating.md`).
